import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc

# expr(a: A3 (string 3), v: Vec4 (array of N4 size 4), p: P, k: K, flag: B)
# slots: a buffer x0, a chars x1..x3, v composite x4, v[0..3] x5..x8,
# p composite x9, p.inner composite x10, p.inner.n x11, p.tag x12, k x13, out x14
campaign = {
  "types": [
    {"name": "A3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
    {"name": "N4", "kind": "int", "bits": 4},
    {"name": "Vec4", "kind": "array", "element": "N4", "size": 4},
    {"name": "Inner", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["n", "N4"]]},
    {"name": "P", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["inner", "Inner"], ["tag", "A3"]]},
    {"name": "K", "kind": "int", "bits": 3},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}
  ],
  "modules": [
    {"name": "expr", "params": [["a", "A3"], ["v", "Vec4"], ["p", "P"], ["k", "K"]],
     "result": ["out", "B"],
     "requires": ["and",
        ["all", "x", ["var", "v"], ["implies", ["gt", ["var", "x"], ["const", "N4", 5]],
                                           ["eq", ["var", "x"], ["const", "N4", 9]]]],
        ["not", ["match", ["var", "a"], "b*"]]]}
  ],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["expr"], "machine": None,
  "runs": []
}
runs = []
def run(a, v, inner_n, tag, k, out):
    objs = [("x0", b'')]
    for i in range(3):
        objs.append(("x%d" % (1 + i), enc(ord(a.ljust(3, '\x00')[i]), 1)))
    objs.append(("x4", b''))
    for i in range(4):
        objs.append(("x%d" % (5 + i), enc(v[i], 1)))
    objs.append(("x9", b''))
    objs.append(("x10", b''))
    objs.append(("x11", enc(inner_n, 1)))
    for i in range(3):
        objs.append(("x%d" % (12 + i), enc(ord(tag.ljust(3, '\x00')[i]), 1)))
    objs += [("x15", enc(k, 1)), ("x16", enc(out, 1))]
    return {"entry": "expr", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

# k is 3 bits -> x15 is the k slot: let me recount.
# a buffer x0, a chars x1,x2,x3 ; v composite x4, v[0..3] x5..x8 ;
# p composite x9, p.inner composite x10, p.inner.n x11, p.tag buffer x12, p.tag chars x13,x14,x15 ;
# k x16, out x17
def run(a, v, inner_n, tag, k, out):
    padded_a = a + '\x00' * (3 - len(a))
    padded_t = tag + '\x00' * (3 - len(tag))
    objs = [("x0", b'')]
    objs += [("x%d" % (1 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded_a)]
    objs.append(("x4", b''))
    objs += [("x%d" % (5 + i), enc(value, 1)) for i, value in enumerate(v)]
    objs += [("x9", b''), ("x10", b''), ("x11", enc(inner_n, 1)), ("x12", b'')]
    objs += [("x%d" % (13 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded_t)]
    objs += [("x16", enc(k, 1)), ("x17", enc(out, 1))]
    return {"entry": "expr", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

cases = [
    ("abc", [0, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),   # all ok, a does not start with b -> READY
    ("bcd", [0, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),   # match b* -> FILTERED
    ("abc", [9, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),   # 9 > 5 and == 9 -> ok
    ("abc", [6, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),   # 6 > 5 but != 9 -> FILTERED
    ("abc", [15, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),  # 15 > 5 -> FILTERED
    ("abc", [], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),             # wrong object count -> INVALID_TEST
    ("abc", [0, 16, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 5, 1),  # 16 out of 4-bit range -> INVALID_TEST
    ("abc", [0, 1, 2, 3], 7, "xyz", 8, 1),   # k=8 out of 3-bit range -> INVALID_TEST
]
for case in cases:
    runs.append(run(*case))
campaign["runs"] = runs
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
